title: 真实Grafana签名插件被修改后拒载：隔离保全证据，恢复完整批准制品并保持验签
source: OpsForge 系统方向独立编审 2026-10-21
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 已知部署后有人改动插件产物，MANIFEST签名本身对应原始文件，当前文件哈希不匹配
根因是已签名制品被修改触发完整性拒绝；保全变更证据，从可信来源恢复与目标Grafana兼容的完整签名版本，受控加载并验证插件状态及受影响面板
若确需定制，由开发按签名发布流程提供新制品；不能删除MANIFEST或放开unsigned配置掩盖修改

conversion.original_title: Grafana重启后某面板插件消失，日志为modified signature且插件文件哈希偏离签名清单，如何恢复？

body:
## 操作任务
实现restore_plugin(archive,destination,quarantine,expected_sha)。先校验批准ZIP完整SHA256，不符ValueError零写；destination为非symlink的现有grafana-clock-panel目录，quarantine为destination.parent.parent下未占用证据路径，处于同一临时文件系统且在插件发现目录之外，不符ValueError。预校验所有ZIP路径只在grafana-clock-panel前缀内、不含../绝对路径/symlink；解到同父目录临时stage，确认完整MANIFEST和plugin.json正确id。将整个原损坏目录rename到quarantine，再把完整原版目录rename为destination；发布失败恢复原目录，finally清理自有stage。返回destination。不覆盖/删除证据、不只覆盖单个JS而留下未批准文件、不删MANIFEST、不放开unsigned或改Grafana配置。真实Grafana先正常验证官方clock-panel2.1.8，修改JS后实际modified signature拒载；恢复后实际signature=valid且module.js HTTP200，原损坏目录逐文件摘要保留。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实Grafana11.6.0签名加载器及官方已签名clock-panel2.1.8，ZIP单独只读挂载、实际数字验签/修改拒载/恢复；目录与发现树之外的证据均自有临时区，不改宿主或外部服务。仅验插件注册和模块资源可取，不证明浏览器Canvas绘制、生产兼容矩阵或滚动上线。官方目录此包只提供MD5一致性值，另记自算SHA256，并由实际Grafana验签建立额外完整性证据；不把自算SHA称为官方SHA。不构建镜像。

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有镜像及只读官方Grafana11.6.0，2GiB；需显式只读签名插件训练素材，不构建镜像

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,json,hashlib,zipfile
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/'checks'))
import task
from grafana_native import PrivateGrafana
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()==1000
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
asset=pathlib.Path('/opt/opsforge-training-assets/grafana-clock-panel-2.1.8.zip');sha='40bbead824a526e11a6006b39fc3286375c289779120b8f8753a7f6aaac72ff9'
assert asset.is_file() and hashlib.sha256(asset.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha,'NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: approved signed plugin readonly asset is missing or differs'
def tree(root):return {path.relative_to(root).as_posix():hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for path in root.rglob('*') if path.is_file()}
def prepare(server):
 with zipfile.ZipFile(asset) as archive:
  for entry in archive.infolist():
   parts=pathlib.PurePosixPath(entry.filename).parts;assert parts and parts[0]=='grafana-clock-panel' and not entry.filename.startswith('/') and '..' not in parts
   target=server.root/'plugins'/pathlib.Path(*parts);assert target.resolve().is_relative_to((server.root/'plugins').resolve())
   if entry.is_dir():target.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
   else:target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(archive.read(entry))
with PrivateGrafana(prepare=prepare) as server:
 directory=server.root/'plugins/grafana-clock-panel';original=tree(directory);manifest=(directory/'MANIFEST.txt').read_bytes();configuration=hashlib.sha256(server.config.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 marker=server.root/'plugins/unrelated-control.txt';marker.write_bytes(b'keep-other-plugin-assets')
 def plugin():
  code,rows=server.request('GET','/api/plugins');assert code==200;return next((row for row in rows if row['id']=='grafana-clock-panel'),None)
 actual=plugin();assert actual is not None and actual.get('signature')=='valid','approved original signed plugin not loaded'
 server.stop();module=directory/'module.js';module.write_bytes(module.read_bytes()+b'\n// deliberate modified teaching artifact\n');(directory/'unapproved-extra.js').write_bytes(b'// not part of approved signed release')
 damaged=tree(directory);server.start();assert plugin() is None and 'modified' in server.logs().lower(),'actual Grafana signature validator did not reject modified artifact'
 print('NATIVE_FAULT_REPRODUCED:actual_grafana_plugin_signature_modified_rejected_while_original_manifest_still_present',flush=True)
 server.stop();quarantine=server.root/'quarantined-modified-clock'
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:preserve_modified_directory_as_evidence_restore_complete_approved_signed_release_without_unsigned_bypass',flush=True)
 try:result=task.restore_plugin(asset,directory,quarantine,sha)
 except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student signed artifact restoration failed') from error
 server.start();actual=plugin();assert actual is not None and actual.get('signature')=='valid','plugin still rejected or signature enforcement was bypassed'
 code,body=server.request('GET','/public/plugins/grafana-clock-panel/module.js');assert code==200 and isinstance(body,str)
 assert pathlib.Path(result)==directory and tree(directory)==original,'complete approved release not restored, extra file left behind or evidence lost'
 assert quarantine.is_dir() and tree(quarantine)==damaged and (quarantine/'MANIFEST.txt').read_bytes()==manifest,'original modified artifact evidence not preserved exactly'
 assert marker.read_bytes()==b'keep-other-plugin-assets' and hashlib.sha256(server.config.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==configuration and hashlib.sha256(asset.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha
 server.stop();untouched=tree(directory)
 try:task.restore_plugin(asset,directory,server.root/'must-not-create','0'*64)
 except ValueError:pass
 else:raise AssertionError('wrong approved package hash accepted')
 assert tree(directory)==untouched and not (server.root/'must-not-create').exists()
 print('NATIVE_GRAFANA_RESTORED_COMPLETE_ORIGINAL_SIGNED_PLUGIN_VALID_AND_MODULE_HTTP200_MODIFIED_EVIDENCE_CONFIG_AND_OTHER_ASSET_PRESERVED',flush=True)
 print('SCOPE:real plugin signature loader and module asset; no browser canvas rendering, production plugin rollout or unsigned policy relaxation is claimed',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
